scenarios.name: Transfer an available command after changing the target

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and the Part 3D Model target
the Part Tools custom panel list is initially empty
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available command list
the user opens the target selector
the user selects the Part Tools target
"2D Sketches" remains selected in the available command list
the Part Tools custom panel list is empty
the user clicks the add command button
"2D Sketches" appears in the Part Tools custom panel list
the target shows a pending-change marker
